Name: Tig's Bus Edits
Author: TigerToony
Description:
[size=3][b]ABOUT[/b][/size]
This mod tweaks the pixel work for the bus making it a bit more detailed and similar to real buses. It also has a bonus toggle to replace the generic bus driver during the introduction to Pam. It should edit all instances of the bus into the new look, but let me know if I missed any. Feel free to suggest features as well.

[b][size=3]FEATURES[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]redrawn/edited bus sprite[/*]
[*]seasonal bus sprite changes[/*]
[*]bus sprite uses summer palette for desert[/*]
[*]optional pam as intro bus driver[/*]
[*]optional replace stairs with ramp[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b]
Likely will break with most other mods that edit the bus. Pam as the intro bus driver option works with my own sprite edit of Pam, but will default to vanilla Pam otherwise. Will auto-detect and change accordingly for the following recolor mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor[/url] (requires CMCT)[/*]
[/list]
